name: Invoice List
description: A filterable invoice list with paid, open and failed marks, tabular amounts, and a download that turns into a check. Narrow widths collapse it into cards.

props.name: invoices
props.type: { id: string; date: string; amount: number; status: "paid" | "open" | "failed" }[]
props.description: Invoices, newest first once sorted. date is an ISO date.

props.name: filter
props.description: Which status is showing. Pass it with onFilterChange to control the filter; omit it and the list keeps its own.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when a filter chip is chosen.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when a row's download is pressed. The button turns into a check either way.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: an open invoice, the open total, and a download after it has been saved.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. Light deepens the accent for text so it stays readable.
